description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of "Incorrect" and "Correct" values across different categories, labeled from 0 to 4 on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis is labeled "U/C" and ranges from 0.0 to 0.6 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The chart features grouped bars, with each group consisting of two bars representing "Incorrect" and "Correct" values, distinguished by blue dotted and red striped patterns, respectively. The "Incorrect" bars decrease in height from left to right, with values ranging from approximately 0.25 at category 0 to around 0.05 at category 4. In contrast, the "Correct" bars also decrease in height, with values ranging from about 0.6 at categories 0 and 1 to around 0.25 at category 4. The bars are grouped by category, with the "Incorrect" bar positioned to the left of the "Correct" bar in each group. The chart does not display any specific sorting or visual emphasis on particular bars beyond the color and pattern distinctions provided by the legend.
